# Valmet

> Valmet is a global technology leader providing process technologies, automation, and lifecycle services to the pulp, paper, energy, and biomaterial industries.

Valmet serves customers worldwide with solutions spanning process optimization, flow control, fiberline measurements, and energy services. The company operates through Process Performance Solutions and Biomaterial Services segments, supporting industrial transformation toward sustainability and circular economy principles.

## Key Topics

- Pulp and paper industry
- Process optimization
- Automation solutions
- Energy services
- Sustainability
- Industrial technology
- Lifecycle solutions
- Flow control
- Biomaterial services
- Circular economy
